text_block_list.text:
On this day, Biko Pegasus visited the underpass
as part of his training.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
All right! Today's the day I master
the Pegasus Tornado, just watch me—... Huh?

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
...*inhale*, *exhale*—
"I am a flower. A red rose flower.
Look at me. Aren't I bright red and pretty?"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Heeey!
Whatcha doing over there?

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
"...Huh!? Justice Biko!?
I watched your race! And the hero show too!
Both of them were super cool!"

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text: "Just like a real hero... And seeing that gave me the motivation to never give up and keep doing my best!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~! That makes me so happy!
I see, so what kind of things
are you working hard on right now?

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
I'm in the school's drama club, you see.
To be honest, though, I'm not very good at acting...
I thought I wasn't cut out for it, and almost quit.

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text: “Right then, I saw you run! Even with a small body, without ever thinking it wasn't for you, I saw you racing out there, Biko!”

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Oh! And that motivated you to do your best too!?
Knowing I gave you courage makes me kinda happy!

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
"Watching Biko work so hard inspires me
to keep doing my best too! Like, I won't lose either!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah! I won't lose either!
I'm gonna run so amazingly well
that everyone will just want to chase after me!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
For example, umm...
Winning by a huge margin... overtaking everyone at once... hmm...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Trainer! Got any good goals for me!?
Something that'll really get this guy all fired uuuuup!"
choice_data_list: Win 4 graded sprint races in a flash!
Win 7 graded sprint races with style!
Four graded wins at the mile—bam!
Seven graded wins at the mile—pow!

text_block_list.text: I told Biko Pegasus that she could definitely achieve the goal of winning 4 or more graded sprint races.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Oh! I love that idea!
4 Graded wins in the Sprint! I'm gonna do it—!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to me, Trainer!
A hero shines brightest on a rugged path!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Hardships and trials are nothing to me! A thorny path is my path!
I'll make a flower path of justice bloom for all to see!

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Ah... That's it! That's Aegis Red's
catchphrase from "Aegis Ranger", isn't it!?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Heheh! I feel the exact same way!
Justice Biko never takes detours when facing a rugged road!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Straight ahead! Charge forward!
Like a true hero! Like the real me!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
So――come watch my race, alright?!
Your cheers will be my strength!

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, of course!
I definitely won't miss seeing you win, Biko!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Heheh... Trainer!
I kinda like this sort of thing!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I've got another goal I want to work hard for!
All right! Let's do this!

And so, Biko Pegasus and the young girl
exchanged a passionate promise.
I told Biko Pegasus that she could definitely achieve the goal of winning 7 or more graded sprint races.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Seven or more graded stakes victories!?
choice_data_list: Of course, it's going to be a tough battle...!
Of course, it's going to be a tough battle...!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, bring it on! Besides... our battles up until now have been tough enough already!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Even so! We've always overcome hardships together, the two of us, haven't we?!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"So don't worry!
When you and I team up,
there's no hurdle we can't overcome!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: You're ready, right, partner!?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Heheh, now that's what I wanted to hear!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
All right, let's do this!
You better come cheer for me too, got it?!

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Whenever you're in a race, Biko,
I'll definitely be cheering for you!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Thank you!
I promise I'll live up to your expectations!

And so, Biko Pegasus and the young girl
exchanged a passionate promise.
